correctness.rationale: The pairwise independent coefficient columns prove rank-two smoothness of X and C and show the second projective eigenspace is empty. Adjunction gives genus C=10; the normal scalar action produces transverse quotient 1/3(1,1), smooth blowup quotient and discrepancy -1/3. The nontrivial ω² residue character and quasi-etale cover give canonical index exactly three. c3(X)=-16H³, ∫H³=9 imply χ(X)=-144, b3=148; Lefschetz for fixed genus-ten curve yields trace 22 and invariant H³ dimension64, of which h21=32; blowup adds ten to h21 and one to h11. Euler crosscheck confirms χ(Z)=-78. Dependency-free exact checker executed successfully, but the full infinite-parameter proof is mathematical, not a finite enumeration.

value.rationale: Billi--Palomino--Sarti explicitly present removal of empty-fixed-locus assumption as the next problem. The theorem provides a whole admissible three-parameter family of odd-dimensional index-three Log Enriques varieties, local noncanonical singularity and discrepancy data, an explicit projective smooth resolution, and exact Hodge/Euler invariants. Hodge numbers of a noncrepant resolution are geometrically informative and not implied by free quotient tables; the family and invariant are natural rather than arbitrary.
